lines.text: A man or woman who vows to be a Nazirite must abstain from wine and strong drink.
For the entire period of the vow, no sword shall touch the Nazirite's head, and his hair must grow long.
The Nazirite must not go near a dead body, even if his father or mother dies.
After a sudden death, he shaves on the seventh day and brings two turtledoves on the tenth day.
At the Tent of Meeting the Nazirite shaves his head, puts the hair on the fire, then may drink wine.
